T: A teenage rock and roll star from the San Fernando Valley.
D: The short, bright career of 1950s rock and roll star Ritchie Valens.
P: Serve the mains when Ritchie plays the party at home.
S: the family party in the backyard

Masa beaten light with lard and stock, spread on soaked corn husks, filled with pork braised in red chilli, folded and steamed until firm. Simmer 600g pork shoulder in salted water for 2 hours, then shred. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin, and stir through the pork. Soak 16 corn husks for 30 minutes. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 450g masa harina, 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 450ml warm stock. Spread masa on each husk, add pork, fold and steam upright for 75 minutes.
the trip across the border with his brother
Grilled skirt steak chopped fine, in small corn tortillas with onion, coriander, lime and a fiery salsa verde.
Thin fries soaked in cold water for an hour, dried, fried at 140C then again at 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper boats with tomato sauce.
M: Pork shoulder simmered with hominy, garlic and a red chilli sauce for 3 hours, served with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.
a 1950s diner in the San Fernando Valley

Two thin chuck patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese melted between, with pickles, diced onion, mustard and tomato sauce on toasted soft buns. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls of 100g. Heat a heavy pan or flat plate until smoking. Add the balls, smash flat with a spatula, season with salt and cook 2 minutes until deeply browned. Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Stack two patties on each toasted bun with dill pickles, finely diced white onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: the girl he writes the song for

Short grain rice simmered with a cinnamon stick and lemon peel in water, then milk added and stirred slowly for 30 minutes until creamy, finished with condensed milk and ground cinnamon. Simmer 200g short grain rice with a cinnamon stick, a strip of lemon peel and 500ml water until absorbed. Add 750ml milk and stir slowly for 30 minutes until creamy. Stir in half a can of condensed milk, remove the cinnamon and dust with ground cinnamon.
K: Vanilla ice cream, cold milk and malted milk powder blended until thick, poured into tall glasses with a straw. Blend 4 big scoops of vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 4 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into tall chilled glasses, add a straw to each and serve straight away like a fifties soda fountain.

s.note: the trip across the border with his brother
s.how: Grill 600g skirt steak over high heat, rest and chop finely. Blend charred tomatillos with coriander, lime and a little onion for a sharp salsa verde. Pile the steak into warm corn tortillas with diced white onion, coriander and the salsa.

Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for an hour. Dry well, fry at 140C until soft, then fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and serve in paper boats with tomato sauce on the side.

m.how: Toast and soak dried chillies, then blend with garlic and a little water. Simmer 1kg pork shoulder in water for 2 hours, add the chilli sauce and a can of drained hominy and simmer another hour. Shred the pork and serve with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.
